title: Each role's menu
sub: Turn a page, its tabs and its buttons on or off. The menu the person will see changes with you.
backDone: {{role}}: back to the basic role (not saved yet)
adminAll: The administrator always has everything: it is not set here.
agenceHint: The agents of a confirmation agency working in the shop
pageOff: Page off: it leaves the menu, with its tabs.
extraSub: The short list of what can be given on top. It used to be in Preferences or on a person's card.
none: Not possible for {{role}}: {{pages}}. These pages stay with their roles and the administrator.
peopleSub: When one person must have more or less than their role
personHelp: Take away what {{name}} must not do, or give them on top what the list allows. The rest follows their role.
personHas: What they have through their role
personCan: What can be given to them on top
personNothing: Nothing to give this person on top.
saved: Rights saved: the team's screens follow at once
formExtras: Their extra rights (team accounts, « To assign », Assignment) are set in Users › Roles › One person apart.
prefsMoved: « Who can change the company » and « Who writes the Pilot rules » are now set in Users › Roles, role by role.
noItems: Your role does not change the products or the prices (Users › Roles).
noCustomer: Your role does not change the customer or the address (Users › Roles).

x.assign: Choose the parcels' company or livreur
x.affect: Share the orders out between the agents

xHelp.users: Create accounts and change passwords, never an administrator's. Before: « Can create accounts and change passwords ».
xHelp.assign: Depot › « To assign ». Before: « Can assign orders ».
xHelp.affect: Management › Assignment. Before: « Can set the assignment ».
xHelp.rules: Pilot Automations › Auto Pilot Assign. Before: in Preferences.

orders.customer: Change the customer and the address
orders.items: Change the products and the prices
orders.give: Give an order to an agent
orders.send: Send the parcels to the company
orders.parcelCancel: Cancel a parcel at the company

act.costs: See the purchase price and the margin

conf.photos: Send the product's photos to the customer

suivi.parcel: Change a parcel at the company

caisse.add: Add an expense or a payment
caisse.transfer: Hand the money to another cash box

ads.control: Turn on, stop, change an ad's budget
ads.owner: The owner's decisions on the ads

catalog.send: Send the products to the Meta and TikTok catalogue

landing.edit: Create and change the landing pages
landing.protect: Block or give back fake orders

orders.customer: Name, phones, wilaya, commune, address, desk
orders.items: Products, quantities, prices, discount, fees (never below the maximum discount)
orders.cancel: Cancelled, wrong number, duplicate, fake order
orders.company: On an order that already has one. Before: in Preferences.
orders.export: The lists, with the numbers. The app hides the button: the file is made in the browser.

actHelp.costs: In the products, the orders and the numbers

suivi.treat: Call, note the answer, « Next alert »
suivi.claim: To the livreur or to the delivery company
suivi.swap: Send a cancelled parcel to another customer
suivi.parcel: Amount, address: a request to the company

depot.dispatch: Take the parcels out of the depot, send them again
depot.returns: And put them back in stock

sav.exchange: Send another item to the customer

pos.sell: Open and close the counter's cash box

dellal.reply: Pilot Message: answer, turn Dellal on or off

notify.send: WhatsApp or SMS to the customer

promo.settings: And mark the « Awareness » posts and ads

ads.owner: Approve, stop all, budget, currency, marketer

leads.fix: The requests waiting for a person

marketers.pay: Prices and payments per ad set
